description: This file defines a PHP class named CheckSecurityNode within the Twig templating engine. It manages security checks for templates by verifying used tags, filters, and functions during compilation and handling security exceptions.

classes.name: CheckSecurityNode
classes.description: Represents a node in Twig's abstract syntax tree responsible for generating security checks during template compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the security check node with used tags, filters, and functions.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for performing security checks based on the used elements.
